decisions.title: Press higher during build-up
decisions.description: The opponent struggled when pressed inside their defensive third.
decisions.recommendation: Increase the pressing line during the opponent's first phase of build-up to force turnovers in dangerous areas.

decisions.title: Exploit the left half-space
decisions.description: Most dangerous attacks originated from the left half-space.
decisions.recommendation: Increase combinations and progressive passes through the left half-space.

decisions.title: Improve defensive transitions
decisions.description: Counter-attacks generated the highest threat after losing possession.
decisions.recommendation: Reduce the distance between midfield and defensive line immediately after losing possession.
evidence: Recoveries below expected after possession loss
